service_level.applied_as: equality constraint sum_q U_q == U_common in BOTH regimes
service_level.justification: A1 pins every incumbent assignment, so A1's feasible set is contained in A2's and A2 can imitate A1; the containment is CHECKED at run time by assert_incumbent_eligible() and assert_A1_candidates_subset_A2(), not assumed

disruptions.formal_coverage: every active caregiver holding at least one task at q >= T_NOW
disruptions.debug_cap_policy: a finite --max-absent is permitted only for non-formal fixtures or rehearsals and is fatal in formal mode

epsilon.semantics: absolute integer budget on the summed deviation over the whole recovery horizon: sum_q D_q <= epsilon
epsilon.grid_derivation: lo = max over regimes of the minimum attainable total deviation at U_common; hi = max over regimes of the total deviation of that regime's overtime-minimising lexicographic point; grid = every integer in [lo, hi]
epsilon.proof_anchor_policy: solve each new effective epsilon to code-0 Optimal; reuse only fixed-parity equivalents or the already code-0 unconstrained lexicographic W-floor point, with explicit per-row provenance
epsilon.feasibility_of_every_cell: guaranteed by construction: lo is at least A1's deviation floor at U_common and A1's feasible set is contained in A2's, so no cell may be skipped and REQ-2's fail-fast rule can stand

order: min W subject to sum_q D_q <= epsilon
objective.implementation: new proof anchors use separate lexicographic MILPs constrained by prior achieved values; mathematically equivalent requested-epsilon rows reuse only a code-0 anchor with explicit provenance
objective.W_definition: total overtime minutes, recomputed as max(0, load - H_STD) per nurse per slot from the integral assignment

canonical_assignment.rule: lexicographically smallest x under fixed order sorted((slot, task, nurse)), using a sequential fix-to-0-if-feasible sweep after U, W and D are fixed
canonical_assignment.disabled_semantics: assignment_hash is empty and may not be used as cross-run reproducibility evidence
canonical_assignment.formal_policy_reason: assignment identity is not a scientific estimand; formal R1 fixes the numerical (U,W,D) point lexicographically, disables the O(number-of-x) assignment sweep, and requires an empty assignment_hash labelled as not cross-run evidence
canonical_assignment.canonical_result_policy: wall_time_s, node count and solver messages are diagnostics-sidecar fields and are excluded from eps_range.csv / eps_frontier.csv

independent_oracle.shared_data_layer: SubgroupOptimizer.HHCPFullParser is shared and is not independently reimplemented; the incumbent CSV parser, model, constraints, objectives, grid derivation and readback are independent
independent_oracle.grid_authority: the oracle independently derives D_floor and D_at_Wfloor in both regimes, constructs the shared integer [max D_floor, max D_at_Wfloor] grid, and accepts no epsilon list from production
independent_oracle.coverage: every formal R1 (disruption, regime, epsilon) point
independent_oracle.failure_policy: any missing point, non-code-0 oracle solve or disagreement aborts R1; no row may be skipped

runtime_contract.epsilon_anchor_reuse: code0_optimal_anchor_only; parity-equivalent and unconstrained-W-floor rows retain the complete requested integer grid with explicit proof metadata

shard_merge.mode: formal validation and rebuild only; no MILP is solved during merge
shard_merge.axis_authority: rho_manifest.csv plus every referenced H_*.csv and S_*.csv; all active future-task holders are re-derived dynamically
shard_merge.epsilon_axis_authority: the independently generated oracle sidecar is cross-checked against eps_range.csv and every integer frontier cell; merge does not re-solve
shard_merge.receipt: r1_shard_merge_receipt.json records each accepted shard rho, row counts and current four-artifact SHA256 values plus the complete expected and actual axes; it never contains its own hash
shard_merge.failure_policy: missing, duplicate or undesigned rho; mixed SNAP; missing/tampered row; stale source/H/S digest; wrong schema, service level, epsilon grid, solver status, presolve, time limit, provenance or all-active axis aborts before rebuilding

tolerances.cap_allowance_rule: math.ulp(cap) * 8 (s2_core.cap_fp_slack); a fixed 1e-6 is NOT an admissible final pass allowance
tolerances.lexicographic_row_slack_note: The 1e-4 slack is only on the internal 'W <= W*' solver row and is NOT a cap allowance. It is strictly below the 1.0 minimum spacing of achievable W on the registered integral-duration data, so it cannot admit the next W level. Recomputed W values are still compared at 1e-6. A direct rho=.75/seed=1/absent=4 probe showed SciPy 1.13.1/HiGHS falsely returned code 2 at 1e-6 but returned the same (W=627,D=31) at 1e-4; no solver option or retry policy changed. A non-integral instance is refused unless --allow-fractional-durations is passed.
